business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics; written statutes and administrative regulations are primary sources, with judicial interpretations and administrative guidance as supplementary authorities)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement Between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Singapore on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (1985)
Agreement Between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (2003)

Agreement Between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the United States of America for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Tax Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income (1984, as amended by the 1986 Protocol)
Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revision effective 1 January 2025); PBOC and SAMR Joint Order No. 3 (2024) on the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, effective 1 November 2024; Measures for the Administration of Registration of Market Entities; Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Names; Financial Institution Customer Due Diligence and Customer Identity Data Management Measures; PRC Measures for the Administration of Tax Registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Overseas Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas corporate registry or companies office in the parent entity's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: if the country of issuance is a member of the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, the competent local authority must issue an Apostille and no Chinese consular legalization is required. Consular Legalization path: if the country of issuance is not an Apostille Convention member, the document must first be authenticated by the local Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent, then legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate with consular jurisdiction. These two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Status of the Overseas Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas corporate registry, companies office, or equivalent competent registrar in the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: issuance of an Apostille by the designated competent authority in the source jurisdiction, with no subsequent consular legalization. Consular Legalization path: authentication by the source jurisdiction's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, followed by legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in that jurisdiction. The paths are mutually exclusive alternatives; chaining apostille plus consular legalization is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Overseas Parent Authorizing the Formation of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, Appointing the Local Legal Representative and Directors, and Approving the Registered Capital and Business Scope
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas parent entity's board of directors or corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: apostillize the notarized resolution in the parent entity's home jurisdiction; no Chinese consular step follows. Consular Legalization path: notarize the resolution, obtain authentication from the home jurisdiction's foreign affairs authority, and then submit to the Chinese Embassy or Consulate for legalization. Only one path applies based on the source country's Hague membership; never combine both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association and Constitutional Documents of the Overseas Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas corporate registry, registered agent, or legal representative of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: apply for an Apostille from the competent authority in the parent entity's place of registration; the apostilled document is directly acceptable for Chinese governmental and banking due diligence. Consular Legalization path: have the document notarized, authenticated by the source government's foreign affairs office, and then legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate with jurisdiction. The two authentication paths are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and Director/Officer List of the Overseas Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas corporate registry, registered agent, or company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: apostille issuance by the home jurisdiction's competent authority, after which no Chinese consular legalization is performed. Consular Legalization path: domestic notarization, foreign ministry authentication, and Chinese embassy or consulate legalization in the source country. The applicable path must be determined exclusively by whether the source country is an Apostille Convention member state; combining the two methods is a compliance violation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Overseas Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas parent entity's regulated commercial bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: the bank letter, if notarized, must be apostillized by the competent authority of the bank's jurisdiction; no consular legalization follows. Consular Legalization path: the bank letter must be notarized by the local notary, authenticated by the local foreign affairs ministry, and then legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate with jurisdiction over that bank. These parallel authentication routes are mutually exclusive and must not be sequenced together.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, legal representatives, authorized signatories, and the overseas parent entity must be screened against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, the U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, the PRC's own list of sanctioned and anti-money-laundering-disrupted persons, and the PRC judicial dishonest judgment debtor database. PEP screening must cover domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, immediate family members, and close associates. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any PEP, including verification of source of wealth and source of funds, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Negative news and adverse media screening in both Chinese and English is required, and continuous re-screening must occur at least daily during incorporation and for the life of the WFOE.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration System and National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE name must be in standardized Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier naming convention: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or business characteristics, and organizational form. The Chinese name may include a phonetically transliterated parent company name, but it must be locally distinctive and must not duplicate an existing registered name in the same or related industry. English or foreign-language names are not registered as statutory company names in China; any English trade name used in banking, contracts, or REIT documentation must be separately recorded or contractually adopted and must not conflict with the Chinese statutory name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR name registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant should first request a written statement of rejection reasons through the National Enterprise Name Registration System. A formal administrative reconsideration application must be filed with the SAMR at the immediately higher level or with the same-level people's government within 60 days of receipt of the rejection notice, citing the legal basis under the Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Names and rebutting each stated objection. Alternatively, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit with the competent People's Court within six months. The applicant should simultaneously prepare an amended name filing after removing any prohibited or identical-name elements to preserve the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable for a China WFOE engaged in the real estate investment trust industry. The State Taxation Administration requires a physical, verifiable business address for tax registration, and the municipal market regulation authority requires an actual office or commercial premises for the registered address. Chinese banks conducting basic deposit account opening will perform an on-site physical inspection of the office, confirm signage, interview personnel, and verify lease documentation. A mailbox-only or virtual office address will cause rejection of bank account opening and tax registration, create risk of administrative revocation of the business license, and is inconsistent with the commercial substance requirements of the real estate investment trust license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced physical inspection: (i) existence of a lease contract recorded with the local housing and urban-rural development authority; (ii) office signage correctly matching the Chinese registered name; (iii) staff actually present during business hours; (iv) utility bills, tax invoices, and corporate stationery evidencing operations; (v) books and records accessible at the registered address. Quantified risk of an unannounced on-site inspection by municipal tax or market supervision authorities during the first 12 months of a REIT-related WFOE: 60% for a standard office address and 90% if any virtual office or shared mailbox arrangement is attempted. The WFOE should maintain full operational indicia at the registered office at all times.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAMR Enterprise Name Reservation and Company Registration Official Fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff; official enterprise registration and name reservation fees are waived under national policy.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Chinese law firm engaged by the applicant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market hourly rate for a senior associate in Shanghai or Beijing, approximately 250 USD flat fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO Identification, Verification, and Regulatory Filing Preparation Under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Chinese law firm and PEP/sanctions screening platform
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for comprehensive UBO due diligence, PEP screening, OFAC, UN, and domestic adverse media checks.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Apostille or Consular Legalization of Overseas Parent Documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Overseas notaries, foreign ministries, Chinese embassies or consulates, and Chinese translation agencies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular fee schedules, local notarial tariffs, and market rates for certified Chinese translation of corporate instruments.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and Notarization of Board Resolutions and Articles of Association for the WFOE
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese notary public and external law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff for corporate documents and standard legal drafting fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Office Physical Premises Deposit and Lease Documentation Support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial property lessor and local property agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for the first month deposit and legal review of a qualifying office lease in a commercially zoned building.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal Opinion on Commercial Substance, Tax Registration, and REIT License Suitability
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Chinese law firm with corporate and financial regulatory practice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for a Stage 1 legal opinion to the overseas parent and its financiers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation and Certification of Foreign-Owned Enterprise Charter Documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Qualified Chinese translation company and Chinese notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-page certified translation tariff multiplied by estimated charter page count plus notarial certification fee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), particularly Articles 2, 3, 5, 14, 23, 24, 26, 27, 31, 32, 47, 94 and 231; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2, 3, 4, 13, 18 and 28; Regulation of the State Council on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law (State Council Order No. 723); Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746), Chapter II; and applicable SAMR rules on the registration of foreign-invested enterprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration in the jurisdiction of the WFOE's registered office, as the Market Entity Registration Authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Market Entity Registration for the establishment of a foreign-invested limited liability company (WFOE), together with the executed Articles of Association, Shareholders' Establishment Resolution, Appointment Documents for the statutory representative and supervisor, Enterprise Name Reservation Notice, and supporting legalized identity documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-in capital and no blocked escrow account requirement under the PRC Company Law. A WFOE must state a registered capital amount in its Articles of Association. Under Article 47 of the 2023 Company Law, shareholders of a limited liability company must fully pay their subscribed contributions within five years from the date of establishment unless an industry-specific law imposes a shorter period. If the REIT management activities require a financial regulatory license, the China Securities Regulatory Commission or local financial regulatory bureau may impose an independent minimum paid-in capital, net capital, or escrow condition, and that condition is then mandatory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company's registered capital be established at [CNY/USD AMOUNT], divided into [NUMBER] equity interests subscribed as set forth in the Articles of Association; that each shareholder appearing in the register of members be deemed to have irrevocably subscribed for the corresponding number of equity interests and to have agreed to pay the contribution price in accordance with the payment schedule in the Articles of Association and in compliance with Article 47 of the PRC Company Law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby fixed at [FULL ADDRESS IN CHINA], and that the Executive Director is authorized to execute, deliver and perform the lease agreement, landlord certificate of right to use, building ownership certificate, and such other premises documents as the Market Entity Registration Authority may require to evidence the legally valid registered address. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons are hereby appointed to the following statutory offices: [NAME] as Executive Director; [NAME] as General Manager; [NAME] as Supervisor; and [NAME] as Compliance Officer/Company Secretary, each to serve until the first annual meeting or until lawfully removed or replaced. RESOLVED FURTHER, that a bank account or accounts be opened with [BANK NAME AND BRANCH], and that any two of the following authorized signatories, namely the Executive Director, the General Manager and the Compliance Officer, shall jointly sign all account opening forms, bank mandates, cheques, wire transfer instructions and other banking instruments; the same authorized signatories are granted full authority to execute all foreign exchange filings required by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Company adopt the pre-incorporation contracts, employment contracts, seal-control policy, and the internal control and anti-money-laundering compliance manual submitted to this meeting, and that the statutory officers and employees be required to comply therewith. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Executive Director and General Manager be and hereby are authorized, jointly and severally, to prepare, execute, file and submit all documents, applications, licenses, permits, notifications and correspondence to SAMR, tax authorities, the Ministry of Commerce, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the local financial regulatory bureau, SAFE, and any other relevant authority, to pay all incidental fees, and to take all lawful steps necessary to complete the formation, registration and licensing of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all expenses incurred by the organizers and all acts performed before the date of this resolution in connection with the formation of the Company be and are hereby ratified, confirmed and adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that this resolution be effective immediately and may be executed in counterparts, and that the Executive Director cause a true copy to be filed in the Company's corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name pre-approval and business scope screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR Enterprise Registration Online Platform and the local District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration service window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for the proposed Chinese and English enterprise name of the WFOE, with the structure 'City + Trade Name + Industry + Limited Company' and an express indication that the entity is a wholly foreign-owned enterprise. Provide the proposed business scope for the real estate investment trust activities, registered capital amount, shareholder identity, and registered address to the local MSA. The authority will run a negative-list screening, trademark conflict check, and existing-name database check. If the name is unavailable or conflicts with a protected mark, the MSA will issue a written query. The applicant must submit a revised candidate name within the correction period, ensuring no conflicting element remains.
required_dossiers: Name pre-registration application form
Shareholder identity or passport copies and, for a corporate shareholder, a notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation
Proposed business scope description
Power of attorney to the designated representative
Contact information and proposed registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is suspended or rejected, obtain the written statement of reasons, amend the proposed name or business scope to remove the conflicting element, and resubmit within the statutory five-working-day correction window. If the rejection is believed to be erroneous, file an administrative reconsideration with the parent SAMR body within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles of Association and statutory formation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration; notarization with a licensed PRC notary public if the foreign investor's identity or signature requires notarial certification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in the Chinese language, including the company name, registered office, registered capital, shareholder contribution schedule, liability limitation, statutory representative appointment, governance structure, dividend policy, amendment procedure and liquidation terms. The foreign shareholder must execute the Articles of Association and the shareholders' establishment resolution. If the shareholder is a corporate entity, its certificate of incorporation must be notarized in the home jurisdiction and apostilled for use in China, followed by a Chinese translation. The statutory representative must be named and must execute a consent-to-act statement. The complete document package is filed through the SAMR online platform or delivered in person to the district MSA registry.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Association
Shareholders' establishment resolution
Application for Market Entity Registration
Enterprise Name Reservation Notice
Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation of the foreign corporate shareholder, with Chinese translation
Identity documents of the executive director, general manager, supervisor and statutory representative
Lease agreement and landlord property ownership certificate for the registered office
Consent of the statutory representative to accept appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MSA issues a correction notice, the applicant must submit supplemental documents online within 15 days. If the matter concerns an incomplete translation or missing apostille, cure by obtaining the authenticated Chinese translation and resubmitting. If the application is rejected, request an administrative review before SAMR or file a court action according to the Administrative Procedure Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company registration, issuance of Business License, and seal engraving and filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration under SAMR; approved seal engraving bureau and local public security authority for seal records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed market entity registration application with the local MSA and receive the electronic and physical Business License containing the unified social credit code. The official state filing fee is zero. Upon issuance, the company must engage a SAMR-approved seal engraving company to produce the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal and the legal representative's personal seal, and must record impressions of these seals with the local public security authority. The WFOE must also complete its tax registration on the e-Tax platform within 30 days after the Business License date and select its taxpayer status as general or small-scale VAT taxpayer according to projected revenue.
required_dossiers: Approved market entity registration application and name reservation certificate
Executed Articles of Association with company seal affixed
Shareholder and officer identity documents
Proof of right to use the registered address
Appointment documents for statutory representative and supervisor
Business license application sheet
Tax registration information notification form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is suspended due to a premises defect, cure by obtaining a landlord consent certificate, revising the lease term, or producing an updated building ownership certificate. If the MSA rejects on a substantive point, appeal through SAMR administrative reconsideration within the statutory period. Any tax registration delay should be cured immediately through the online e-Tax portal to avoid late-registration penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation filings: tax registration, bank account opening, SAFE foreign exchange registration, social insurance and statistical reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local district office of the State Taxation Administration; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) acting through an authorized designated bank; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Information System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Business License is obtained, the WFOE must complete tax registration at the local tax district, open a basic deposit account in CNY and a foreign currency capital account at a SAFE-authorized bank, and register the foreign investment information report with SAFE and the Ministry of Commerce's comprehensive foreign investment information system. The company must also enroll employees in social insurance and housing provident fund, register for payroll withholding, and complete the annual market entity annual report filing. For REIT-related cross-border capital flows into the Chinese real estate portfolio, a foreign exchange registration confirmation form must be obtained from the bank, supported by the business scope and the executed investment documents.
required_dossiers: Business License and unified social credit code certificate
Articles of Association and registration resolution
Company seal, financial seal and legal representative seal
Identity documents of statutory representative and financial officer
Bank account opening application and SAFE registration questionnaire
Foreign exchange registration confirmation form after bank approval
Office lease contract and rent invoices
Employee appointment contracts and social insurance registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority withholds activation pending an e-tax payment agreement, upload the bank account certificate and re-submit. If SAFE rejects the foreign exchange registration due to an inconsistent business scope, amend the Articles of Association, obtain a revised Business License, and refile. Late filings are subject to fines under the Tax Administration Law, so an expedited administrative reconsideration and immediate supplemental filing must be initiated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable to physical industrial licensing; this ISIC 6499 real estate investment trust entity is office-based rather than an ISIC 1xxx-5xxx industrial operation. For REIT or fund management activities, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) and the local financial regulatory bureau are the competent financial licensing authorities; the Market Entity Registration Authority controls the commercial scope.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or physical industrial operating license applies. For REIT or fund management operation, the WFOE must hold a 'Financial Business License' or 'Private Fund Manager Registration' issued by the CSRC or the Asset Management Association of China if the entity acts as the investment manager; if the WFOE only holds and administers an owned real estate portfolio, the ordinary Market Entity Business License with an approved real estate investment scope is sufficient.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) / local Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable (Exempt) — the ISIC 6499 REIT business is a pure office-based portfolio-management activity with no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing project requiring a Full EIA Report or Environmental Registration Table.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — no wastewater, VOC or hazardous waste discharge is generated by a pure REIT management office. If the WFOE later acquires physical real estate assets undergoing redevelopment, the construction phase must comply with the integrated wastewater discharge standard GB/T 31962-2015 for municipal sewer wastewater (COD <= 500 mg/L, BOD5 <= 300 mg/L, SS <= 400 mg/L, pH 6-9), the national ambient air quality standard GB 3095-2012, and hazardous waste transfer through qualified parties under the PRC Solid Waste Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for a pure office-based REIT vehicle; no Civil Defense fire permit is required for non-production office premises beyond the building owner's fire safety inspection and occupancy certificate. The WFOE must, however, maintain workplace fire safety compliance, conduct annual fire drills, and register occupational health and safety procedures under the Work Safety Law. A local fire authority civil-defense clearance and structural load inspection will apply only if the entity later constructs or acquires physical storage, warehouse, or redevelopment facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic tax filing portal: the Electronic Tax Bureau at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-invested Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), the statutory TIN is obtained as follows: (1) Register the entity with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) or its local counterpart and obtain the Business License. (2) Within 30 days after Business License issuance, apply for tax registration with the competent tax authority by submitting the standard tax registration application form prescribed by the STA, the Business License, Articles of Association, investment contract, and identification of the legal representative. (3) The tax authority assigns a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) which constitutes the enterprise's taxpayer identification number (TIN), used for all CIT, VAT, and other filings. (4) If the entity qualifies as a general VAT taxpayer, complete the VAT general taxpayer registration. (5) A foreign non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China may apply for a non-resident taxpayer identification number through the same competent tax authority when it needs to self-file or claim treaty benefits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. China's tax law does not provide a check-the-box election or hybrid-mismatch election mechanism for this entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 in annual taxable sales (excluding VAT) for mandatory general taxpayer registration; below this threshold, small-scale taxpayer status is available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The State Taxation Administration operates a nationwide electronic invoicing system under the Golden Tax Phase IV framework. All VAT invoices must be issued through the official e-Invoice platform, which employs API-based integration with enterprise accounting systems. Invoices are assigned unique digital codes and transmitted in real time to the STA central database. Mandatory digital encryption and stamping apply to each invoice to prevent forgery. Full digital invoices (without physical paper) are used for most transactions. Real-time fiscal clearance is achieved through automatic database matching of invoice data with payment reconciliations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods from mainland China is eligible for VAT zero-rating, provided the goods are actually exported and customs clearance records are maintained. Qualifying cross-border services, including software development, technical consulting, and other designated modern services provided to overseas customers, are also zero-rated. The exporter must be a VAT general taxpayer, the export proceeds must be received in foreign currency within the prescribed repatriation period, and the service must be used entirely outside China. Documentation must prove the flow of goods or services and the corresponding foreign-exchange receipt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (release certificate) issued by China Customs
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) issued by the carrier
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank receipt confirming export proceeds in foreign currency)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Any false or inaccurate zero-rating claim will result in the denial or recovery of the VAT refund (clawback) together with interest for late payment. The tax authority may impose administrative fines of one to five times the amount of the fraudulently obtained refund. If the conduct constitutes criminal tax fraud (Article 204 of the Criminal Law), imprisonment and fines are applicable. Additionally, the exporter's credit rating may be downgraded, and future export refund privileges may be suspended.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), operating under the supervision of the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a regulated, asymmetric convertibility framework: current account transactions are generally convertible after authenticity and compliance checks by designated commercial banks, while capital account transactions remain subject to PBOC and SAFE registration, bank verification, or approval. A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise established as a REIT must complete foreign exchange registration for its foreign direct investment through a domestic settlement bank before it can receive inbound equity capital from offshore shareholders. Foreign-currency capital contributions must first enter a dedicated foreign exchange capital account and cannot be credited directly to a general operational RMB account. Conversion of such capital into RMB is permitted under the bank-based capital account settlement regime, but the resulting RMB funds must be deployed strictly in line with the approved business scope, the negative list for foreign investment, and the project purpose described in the application. Profit remittances and dividend distributions to foreign investors are treated as current account outflows and are permitted only after the WFOE has completed the annual statutory audit, paid or settled applicable taxes, and provided the bank with the prior-year financial statements, dividend resolution, and tax clearance evidence. These controls make treasury operations slower and more document-intensive than in fully liberalized jurisdictions, but they are manageable for a licensed, audited WFOE with a clear tax identity and a fully qualified domestic banking relationship.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China abolished mandatory export proceeds surrender for goods trade. Under the current SAFE framework, export-related foreign currency receipts must be repatriated to a domestic bank settlement account by the documented contract due date and generally within 180 days after the export customs declaration. The exporter may retain eligible export proceeds in a foreign exchange settlement account or voluntarily convert them to RMB at market rates; there is no statutory fixed percentage conversion ratio. For a WFOE structured as a real estate investment trust, export trading revenue is typically absent, so the relevant obligation applies only to ancillary cross-border goods or services revenue, which must be declared through the bank's trade monitoring system with supporting customs declarations, invoices, contracts, and logistics evidence.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low / Not Viable as a primary banking rail. China does not permit unlicensed offshore digital EMIs or foreign payment fintechs to open onshore corporate bank accounts, hold client funds, perform capital verification, or issue clearing channels for a domestic WFOE. Offshore EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer, or Airwallex can only provide auxiliary cross-border collection or disbursement support through Chinese-licensed non-bank payment institutions, but they cannot act as the legal settlement bank for equity injection, FX conversion, profit remittance, or regulatory declarations. The WFOE must keep its principal treasury accounts with a licensed domestic commercial bank; any EMI solution is restricted to tenant rent collection or low-value ancillary payment attachments and may not replace the domestic bank relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is mandatory. Chinese banks generally require the legal representative, the statutory business licensee, and the principal authorized signatories to appear in person at a domestic branch for face-to-face KYC interviews and original document verification at account opening. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted as a substitute. In certain cases, a bank may permit a locally designated authorized person to act on behalf of the foreign legal representative if there is a notarized and legalized power of attorney, full corporate documentation, and enhanced due diligence approval from the compliance committee, but the bank still retains discretion to demand a physical visit by the ultimate beneficial owners or the senior directors before activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership opacity caused by a layered offshore REIT sponsor, discretionary trust, or holding company in a low-disclosure jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified chain of constitution documents from the ultimate investor through every intermediary SPV or trust; trust deed and registered agent letter; 100% share register; identification documents for every natural person holding a controlling interest or 25% or more beneficial ownership; sanctions and PEP screening results for all such persons; a notarized WFOE board declaration; and a corporate transparency report prepared by the sponsor's registered legal counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified source of equity capital when the inbound remittance comes from an offshore financial center or from accounts whose funding source is not consistent with the sponsor's published net worth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited sponsor and fund financial statements for the preceding two years; original bank statements for the remitting account showing no commingling with unrelated parties; private placement subscription agreements and contribution notices; source-of-wealth memorandum for each material investor; prior-year tax returns or tax payment certificates; shareholder loan capital formation records; and an AML opinion from the sponsor's in-house compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Economic substance and genuine business purpose mismatch for an ISIC 6499 real estate investment trust that holds no operating real estate on the balance sheet at the time of onboarding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed property acquisition MOUs or sale-and-purchase agreements; independent appraisals; host country property ownership searches; REIT investment management agreement; three-year cash flow and rental income forecast; board minutes approving the trust strategy; evidence of local substance including office lease, payroll, employment records, and contractual service providers; and a tax and legal opinion confirming the structure is not a shell conduit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons, sanctions, or adverse media events affecting the directors, shareholders, or proposed counterparties in the real estate transaction chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PEP questionnaire for all directors, shareholders, and investment managers; real-time sanctions and PEP screening outputs with date and system reference; external negative news due diligence report; criminal record or background check from the jurisdiction of origin; notarized passport copies; denied-party list screening for all material counterparties; and a recommendation package for enhanced due diligence approval by the bank's compliance committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be sent via SWIFT MT103 or equivalent bank wire from the foreign investor's account to the WFOE's dedicated foreign exchange capital account at a licensed domestic bank. The remittance must clearly reference the registered FDI code and use the SAFE-designated foreign exchange declaration purpose code for foreign direct investment equity injection rather than a current account trade remittance code. After receipt, the banker must verify the authenticity of the investment contract, shareholder resolution, and FDI registration; the WFOE then applies for conversion of the foreign currency capital into RMB under the bank-based settlement regime. Capital verification must be completed by a Chinese certified public accountant after the funds are credited, and the verification report must be filed with the company registration authority and retained by the bank for subsequent payment-use monitoring. Converted RMB may then be released for permitted real property acquisition, construction, and operating expenses only in accordance with the approved foreign investment negative list.

stage_4.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and treasury disbursements are executed through the domestic clearing bank using SWIFT MT103 for straight foreign-currency payments and RMB CIPS messages for cross-border RMB payments. For goods-based or construction-related procurement, Commercial Letters of Credit and Documentary Collections are acceptable where real invoices, transport documents, and property service contracts exist. Because a REIT is treated as a financial services vehicle, disbursements tied to investment management fees, dividend distributions, and capital repatriation must be supported by audited financial statements, board dividend resolutions, tax withholding certificates, and SAFE-compliant profit remittance filings; the bank will not process speculative or unsupported outbound flows.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB/USD forward contracts executed with a licensed domestic bank under SAFE derivative rules, requiring real trade, current account, or capital account underlying exposure and documentary support.
Onshore foreign exchange swaps between RMB and USD for matching debt service, equity injection, or profit repatriation cash flows; no naked or speculative positions are permitted.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) are allowed only for registered external debt or foreign investment exposures with real interest and principal obligations, subject to bank risk appetite and SAFE record-filing.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are generally not permissible as a standalone hedge for an onshore WFOE; use of NDFs through foreign counterparties would breach SAFE's real-demand principle and must be avoided unless a licensed offshore treasury entity exists with separate regulatory approval.
stage_4.central_bank_regulations_note: All foreign exchange transactions must be conducted through the counterparty bank's SAFE-authorized system, and all wires should include accurate transaction codes to avoid false declaration penalties, delayed clearing, or capital account freezing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Market Entity Information Publicity Report (annual company report to the State Administration for Market Regulation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 to June 30 covering the immediately preceding calendar year; one filing per year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by June 30 places the WFOE on the SAMR List of Abnormal Operations; if the filing is corrected, the entity may be removed; if the non-compliance persists for 3 consecutive years, the company is moved to the List of Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises, triggering cross-department credit restrictions, disqualification of the legal representative for up to 3 years, inability to participate in public procurement, and possible administrative revocation of the business license; no automatic abatement of penalties and no automatic re-registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Reconciliation and Final Settlement Return (Enterprise Income Tax annual filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the competent local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following each calendar year; operating entities also file quarterly prepayments due on April 15, July 15, October 15 and January 15
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to a penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 (or RMB 20,000 if serious) and a daily late payment surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax; underpayment is subject to a penalty of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax; continued non-payment may lead to tax authority enforcement, asset attachment, property seizure, restraint on exit of the legal representative, and cancellation of tax registration with cross-departmental adverse credit consequences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (annual foreign investor/FIE information filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), collected through the SAMR annual report system with data shared to the commerce authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 to June 30 for the prior year; changes in foreign investor holdings, including share transfers, must be reported within 15 days of the change and updated in the SAMR registration within 30 days of the equity transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A WFOE that fails to file or falsely files the foreign investment information is ordered to rectify; if rectification is not made within the prescribed period, MOFCOM may impose an administrative fine (commonly up to RMB 100,000 and potentially higher under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures) and the credit record may be publicly marked; recurring failure may make the WFOE ineligible for incentives, restrict capital account transactions, and expose directors and the legal representative to adverse credit and deregistration-risk procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual FDI Existing Equity and Assets-Liabilities Survey (Foreign Exchange Direct Investment Stock Rights Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the Digital SAFE platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before June 30 following the reporting year; separate transaction-level reporting applies to capital injections, dividends, and equity transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to complete the annual foreign exchange survey may result in the WFOE being placed on SAFE's foreign exchange supervision list, suspension of foreign exchange payment services, restrictions on dividend remittances, capital reductions, equity transfers, and cancellation proceedings, and administrative penalties for false or untimely submissions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: REIT-Sector Annual Regulatory and Fund Disclosure Filing (if the WFOE operates or manages an income-generating real estate trust under CSRC/AMAC scope)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) and the Asset Management Association of China (AMAC) through their disclosure systems
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after each fiscal year end for the annual report (by March 31); within 2 months after the June 30 half-year end for the interim report; quarterly reports within 15 working days after each quarter end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to timely disclose or false disclosure may be sanctioned by CSRC under the Securities Investment Fund Law; penalties include a warning, an order to correct, fines (the standard statutory band for disclosure violations commonly ranges from RMB 100,000 to RMB 600,000), bans on responsible directors and managers from acting as fund professionals, suspension of business, and in extreme cases revocation of the CSRC/AMAC registration or license, which would terminate the WFOE's REIT operating authority.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under PRC Company Law, every company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, must prepare annual financial accounting reports and have them audited by an accounting firm licensed in China; there is no minimum balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption for an active WFOE. As a practical quantitative floor, any WFOE with total assets greater than zero, any operating revenue, or any employees is subject to mandatory statutory audit if it is a reporting foreign-invested enterprise. In addition, REIT vehicles investing in income-generating real estate must include a certified audit report in their annual regulatory filing and are required to apply fair-value or CAS-based property valuation rules; the audit must be performed by a CPA firm qualified under China's Certified Public Accountants laws and the PRC Audit Standards, with public offering REITs further requiring a CSRC-approved audit firm.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/PRC GAAP), substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); REIT financial reports additionally apply CSRC information-disclosure rules, evaluation provisions for real estate investment funds, and AMAC prudential supervision requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A WFOE must keep its shareholder register and actual-controller records current at all times. The SAMR annual report requires confirmation of shareholders, ultimate actual controllers, paid-in capital, and equity transfer information for the preceding year. Any shareholding transfer must be reflected in the register of members and filed with SAMR within 30 days of the transfer; the foreign investment information module requires the transfer to be reported to MOFCOM within 15 days. There is no separate Chinese national UBO re-filing each year for a private WFOE, but the annual foreign-investment report and the annual credit publicity report together constitute the annual UBO confirmation; false UBO or controller statements may trigger SAMR adverse records, AML penalties under China's anti-money laundering legal framework, and disqualification of responsible officers.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,200 per year for a licensed registered office or corporate service agent in a main commercial city
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 6,500 per year for a standard WFOE audit, exclusive of REIT special-purpose valuation reports

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The standard CIT rate is 25%; a preferential 15% rate applies to qualifying High-New-Technology Enterprises and to eligible encouraged industries in China's Western Development Program (and Advanced-Technology Service Enterprises for cross-border service income, subject to conditions). A WFOE-REIT operating income-generating real estate generally remains at 25% unless it obtains special qualification; certain C-REIT restructuring can defer sponsor-level gain, but the property-owning WFOE is taxed on annual rental profit at 25%. R&D super-deductions are not relevant to pure property leasing but may apply to qualifying technology-related property management innovation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form A100000) and attached schedules (including A101010, A102010, A105000, A105080 and the Related-Party Transactions Schedule), filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax portal (e-tax.chinatax.gov.cn) with authorized electronic signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return plus quarterly provisional CIT instalment filings.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly instalments are filed and paid within 15 days after each quarter-end; annual reconciliation return and remaining tax payment are due by May 31 of the following calendar year (within 5 months of fiscal year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue (营业收入): gross rental revenue, property-service fees, management-fee income and other ordinary REIT income recognized under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Record revenue net of output VAT shown on the leasing invoice; non-resident shareholders' dividend entitlement does not reduce revenue. Below-market leases to connected offshore parties must be recast at arm's length and may be adjusted under CIT Article 41.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost (营业成本): direct costs of property operation such as utilities, maintenance, cleaning, security, and sub-contracted property-management services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs must be supported by compliant invoices, payroll and bank records; any cross-border intragroup service fee must satisfy the benefit test and be priced at arm's length under a CUP or TNMM method, otherwise deduction is denied.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges (税金及附加): real estate tax, urban land-use tax, stamp duty, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, and other non-CIT operating taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CIT itself, VAT paid on output, late-payment surcharges, income-tax penalties, and dividend withholding tax are not deductible; accidental inclusion of these non-deductible amounts creates an exposure for underpaid CIT and a 50%-500% penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Period expenses (期间费用): selling expenses, administrative expenses, and finance expenses (interest on property-financing loans, guarantees, and FX losses).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest on shareholder/related-party debt is deductible only up to a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio and at an arm's-length rate; the thin-capitalization rules disallow excess interest. Back-to-back shareholder loans without commercial substance are recast as equity and the interest is treated as a non-deductible deemed dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income, fair-value changes and non-operating gains (投资收益/公允价值变动损益/营业外收入): income from disposal of real property, foreign-exchange gain, government grants, or penalty remissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gain on disposal of Chinese real estate held by the WFOE is ordinary taxable income at 25%; no participation exemption applies. Foreign shareholders should separately assess whether an indirect transfer of the entity in future is taxable under the Chinese anti-circumvention rule (Notice 7/2015).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit (利润总额): net result of revenue less cost, taxes, period expenses, adjusted by investment income and non-operating items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This line must reconcile with the audited CAS financial statements; if quarterly instalments were underpaid, interest accrues on the shortfall from the original instalment deadline. Non-resident shareholders must not use a net-equity method to offset WFOE loan balances in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable income (应纳税所得额): total profit plus non-deductible expenditures, less tax-exempt income and allowable loss carryforwards, and including special tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 5-year loss carryforward unless the enterprise qualifies as a High-New-Technology Enterprise (10 years). Withholding taxes on foreign dividends are not deductible. If GAAR redetermines an offshore holding as shell, the corresponding tax returns in prior years may be revisited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable and credits (应纳税额/抵免额): final tax at the applicable rate, foreign-tax credit, enterprise-level preferential tax credits, and the balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Outbound dividend distributions are not deductible against this line. The WFOE must prepare the non-resident withholding schedule, remit 10% (or DTA-reduced) dividend/interest/royalty WHT before the remittance wire, and preserve the approved treaty-benefit file for audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the quarterly or annual return may trigger a TCAL Article 62 penalty of RMB 2,000-10,000 (RMB 10,000-50,000 in serious cases); unpaid tax accrues 0.05% daily late-payment interest under TCAL Article 32. Fraudulent underpayment attracts TCAL Article 63's 50%-500% additional penalty; criminal thresholds under Criminal Law Article 201 are unpaid tax above RMB 50,000 and more than 10% of tax payable, carrying up to 7 years' imprisonment. The tax authority can freeze bank accounts, seize property, and impose an exit ban on the legal representative for unpaid major tax debts.
